title: Before the whole form opens, fromForm saves a pending chat waist or BP silently (H71 D2)
evidence: Before stage 4 a chat waist or blood pressure has no place on screen and waits, unshown, in the form's inputs (widget-src/src/components/ChatEdits.tsx applyFieldEdit: routeVitalsEdit is 'field' while vitalsPrefillRef is null). Any save of the fields before the whole form opens reads inputs: widget-src/src/hooks/useLongitudinalSave.ts fromForm (:78-103) builds a task for weight, waist and systolic/diastolic from inputs under today, so a weight blur or Save as PDF writes the waiting waist or pressure with nothing on screen saying so. Pinned by HealthTool.journey.test.tsx 'US-16 AC1: before the whole form, one chat reply's edits all wait in the form' (:805: a 120/80 reply at stage 1; Save as PDF saves both under today). Once the form opens, the hand-over effect (ChatEdits.tsx useChatEdits, keyed on fullForm) moves them into the grid's draft, so nothing saves them silently after that. Owner's ruling D2 (PR 1508, 2026-11-13): keep the before-open save as it is for now; US-16 AC1 states it. A fix would show or hold the value before stage 4 rather than save it unseen. Also: a fields save already in flight when the form opens reads its stale inputs and saves the waist the grid now holds (useLongitudinalSave.ts save → fromForm after await flushPendingProfileSave); the slot rule allows one row, no loss (PR 1508 re-check). (H72) Done in PR 1579.
